title: wmux settings
description: Settings for wmux.json and the shared cmux.json. Keys use cmux names; wmux-only keys live under "wmux".

$schema.description: Schema URL for editor completion (the wmux or the cmux schema).

schemaVersion.description: Config format version; newer versions are read best effort.

packs.description: Pack files or directories applied beneath this file (values set here win). Relative entries start from this file's directory. A directory resolves to wmux.pack.json, then cmux.pack.json.

portBase.title: Workspace port base
portBase.description: First port of the per-workspace port blocks: each workspace's terminals get CMUX_PORT = base + ordinal * range, CMUX_PORT_END and CMUX_PORT_RANGE. New terminals only.

portRange.title: Ports per workspace
portRange.description: Number of ports reserved for each workspace (CMUX_PORT_RANGE). New terminals only.

preserveAuthEnv.title: Keep Anthropic credentials in terminals
preserveAuthEnv.description: When false (default), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX inherited by wmux are removed from the environment of new terminals.
